definitions: Suggested or hinted at something bad or unpleasant in an indirect and unpleasant way.
Introduced (an idea or feeling) into someone's mind in a subtle, indirect, and artful way.
Slid (oneself or a thing) gradually and stealthily into a place or position.
examples: He insinuated that she was lying.
She insinuated herself into the group.
The thought insinuated itself into his mind.
